title: Completeness, global bounds and etale residue origin from perfect models
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a commutative complete Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and I its unique maximal ideal. A completed-coefficient derived object K satisfying IsSfbStratifiedPerfect [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data] is locally derived complete, has globally bounded cohomology with an ordered integral interval, and has a bounded etale residue complex C with constructible cohomology whose comparison is isomorphic to the canonical residue of K. The construction uses the actual immersion and slice restrictions, the first quotient projection, and fixed-scalar residue of [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data]. This assertion does not include finite Tor amplitude or any triangle closure.

proof.text: On every given stratum cover transport the completed finite-projective model to the equivalent small site. Apply its complete-residue calculation. It gives local completeness, finite-dimensional constant residue cohomology and bounds for the object and its residue, computed by the canonical quotient map. Restriction along immersions and slices identifies these calculations with those of K.

Detect completeness on the finite stratum cover. For both K and its residue choose finitely many quasi-compact pieces of the covering schemes over the finitely many Noetherian strata. Take the minimum lower and maximum upper bound and detect vanishing. Empty families use [0,0].

The residue homology sheaves have finite-dimensional constant values on those strata. Fixed-scalar transport preserves them. Global constructibility on a Noetherian scheme and bounded constructible comparison provide an etale derived representative; choose its cochain preimage under Q and transport its homology and bounds along Q.objObjPreimageIso. The quotient-functor and comparison factors give the displayed residue isomorphism. No Tor conclusion is needed here.

lean.statement:
theorem adicPerfectModels_residueOrigin (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.IsMaximal ∧ ∀ J : Ideal A, J.IsMaximal → J = I)
    [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)))
    (hK : IsSfbStratifiedPerfect X I K) :
    IsSfbAdicComplete X I K ∧
      (∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)) ∧
      ∃ C : CochainComplex
          (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1)))) ℤ,
        (∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) → IsZero (C.homology q)) ∧
        (∀ q : ℤ, IsConstructibleSheaf (C.homology q)) ∧
        Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (sfbResidueComplex X I K) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (A ⧸ I ^ (0 + 1))) X).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj C))
